analysts.list: Lack of AI-ready data puts AI projects at risk

expert.text: Above all, if the data has issues, then the data is not ready for AI.
Organizations will abandon 60% of AI projects through 2026 if they lack AI-ready data; 63% lack or are unsure of suitable data management practices.

line: AI is only as good as the data behind it. Most firms are not ready.
scope: Quality, ownership and access of the data AI uses. Not models or platforms.

sources.name: Gartner
sources.title: Lack of AI-ready data puts AI projects at risk

title: AI-ready data
why: 63% of organisations lack, or are unsure of, data practices fit for AI.
Gartner predicts firms will abandon 60% of AI projects without AI-ready data through 2026.
Agents act on data directly, so errors now turn into actions.
